Companion Animal Travel Desk Handling Notes

This section gives the crew a simple standard for handling traveling pets and the related traveler record. Keep animals calm, keep the carrier secure, and speak clearly with the traveler before boarding begins. The cabin team should check that each pet has food, water, and an approved container, and should note anything unusual right away. If a traveler reports a minor injury, follow the claim intake process and keep the conversation brief and respectful. <<FACT F119>> Place the note in the service record and tell the traveler what comes next.

If a trip is disrupted and a connection is missed, the desk should confirm the facts, support the traveler, and send the case to the right follow-up channel without delay. Keep the tone calm and avoid guessing about outcomes. <<FACT F110>> Share only the approved details, and make sure the traveler understands where the file is going.

For anything outside this guide, contact the senior coordinator at Aurelia Skyways or the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
